long.text: Learn to shape clay into something worth keeping, and build a small collection of my own finds in the house.
long.reason: Clay is good and so are things I have claimed, and I mean to have both in one place.

steps.reason: Something about unknown seeds is still bothering me, and the bookshelf is where that gets answered.
Seeds grow without permission and I want to know how they manage it.
The telescope is mine, and a picture of it keeps the claim on record.
Being above things settles me better than anything else on this island.
From up here I can see who is coming up the beach, and I can pretend I was not looking for them.

today.reason: The bowl is empty and the bookshelf and the telescope are where my curiosity is pulling me, so I will read, photograph and then take the high ground while the light lasts.
